name: parameterized-fault-injection-recovery-runner
title: Add parameterized fault injection to recovery-runner
description: Milestone 2 follow-up from the DNAcoder idea transfer analysis. Add a scoped recovery-runner capability for parameterized and composable fault injection distributions so Proofbound can explore gate robustness beyond the fixed B1-B15 scenario list. This is an offline research harness improvement, not a change to DONE, review, delivery, or evidence hash semantics. It must preserve the existing frozen scenario protocol and avoid optimizing without measured need.

riskSignalsDismissed.reason: False positive: the story explicitly says this is not a production readiness claim and does not modify production or emergency behavior; it only documents a non-goal boundary for an offline recovery-runner research harness.
